compiler_flag_semantics_finding.summary: In rustc 1.102.0-nightly (3ef0c22cd 2026-11-11), CFG_DEFAULT_POLONIUS_NEXT is active so Polonius::DEFAULT == Polonius::Next; bare -Zpolonius parses to Polonius::Legacy, -Zpolonius=next parses to Polonius::Next, and -Zpolonius=off is required to run pure NLL (Polonius::Off).

nll_region_inference.note: Invokes nll::compute_regions, nll::dump_nll_mir, and polonius::dump_polonius_mir before MirBorrowckCtxt dataflow/error checks.

Lowers placeholder outlives constraints into SCCs, emits legacy Polonius facts if requested, computes Polonius::Next loan liveness if enabled, constructs RegionInferenceContext, runs legacy polonius_engine::Output::compute if enabled, and calls regioncx.solve.
Propagates region values over ConstraintSccIndex DAG in dependency order, checks type tests, and dispatches either check_polonius_subset_errors (legacy) or check_universal_regions.
Stores sup: RegionVid, sub: RegionVid, and Locations (All vs Single) used both by NLL SCC propagation and Polonius localization.

opaque_member_constraints.note: Collects defining uses into a throwaway RegionCtxt, applies member constraints, and resolves definition-site hidden types.
Replaces erased non-member regions with fresh existential NLL vars and equates instantiated final hidden type with each use.
Maps constrained region vids to universal regions for diagnostics and remaps generic parameters to opaque declaration params.

Walks constraint SCCs in topological order, filters arg_regions by lower bounds (outlived_by) and upper bounds (rev_scc_graph.upper_bounds), extracts totally_ordered_subset, and picks unique minimum choice region (bailing if incomparable).
Visits hidden_type free regions while skipping Bivariant/uncaptured alias lifetime arguments via opt_alias_variances (supporting RPIT use<...> precise capturing).

two_phase_borrows.note: Converts AutoBorrowMutability::Mut { allow_two_phase_borrow: AllowTwoPhase::Yes } to mir::MutBorrowKind::TwoPhaseBorrow.
Records two-phase borrow assigned to a temporary as NotActivated at reserve_location, then transitions to ActivatedAt(location) on the unique later use of that temporary.
Returns false inside the dominance diamond strictly between reserve_location.successor and activation_location, true after activation or outside the diamond.
Permits Read accesses when !is_active(dominators, borrow, location), while Reservation, Activation, and Write accesses conflict with reserved borrows.
Checks path overlap for reservations and conflicting accesses.

polonius_next_and_legacy.note: Defines Off, Legacy, Next and CFG_DEFAULT_POLONIUS_NEXT compile-time switch.
Bare -Zpolonius selects Legacy; -Zpolonius=next selects Next; -Zpolonius=off selects Off.
Implements -Zpolonius=next loan liveness over LocalizedConstraintGraph and documents time-traveling + kills reachability approximation.
Localizes Single vs All outlives constraints across CFG points and adds forward/backward/bidirectional edges by region variance.
Extracts covariant/contravariant/invariant direction per live region for -Zpolonius=next.
Uses regioncx.is_loan_live_at(loan_idx, location) under Polonius::Next to kill loans when they leave live regions.
Extracts AllFacts (moves, universal regions, CFG edges, loan kills, invalidations, accesses, outlives) for legacy polonius_engine.
Queries polonius_output.errors_at(location) in legacy mode, or dataflow Borrows state in NLL / Polonius::Next mode.
